buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA Text Clause(s) Government of India Ministry of Tribal Affairs Kartavya Bhawan - 1, New Delhi-110001 Scope of Work

In order to ensure supply fresh cut flowers arrangements, indoor plants and flower bouquets as per q uantity mentioned in technical specification which may decrease or increase at Ministry of Tribal Affai rs, New Delhi, the following terms and conditions need to be incorporated in the Tender document of the aforesaid services: - ● The Bidder should have at least five years’ experience in the same category endin g the last day of the month previous to the one in which applications are invite d in providing similar services of fresh cut flowers to PSU’s/Government Depart ments. ● The Bidder should have GST registration. ● The Firm should submit an affidavit on Rs.100/-stamp paper stating t hat the firm is/has not been black listed by any central Government/st ate Government/etc. ● The Bidder should have turnover of at least Rs. 1.00 crore individually for the last three financial years. ● Non-compliance to any of the above conditions by any of the bidders will amount to non-eligibility for the services of such bidders and its te nder will be out rightly rejected. ● Past Experience of Similar Services: The Bidder must have successfully executed / completed at least one single order of 80 % of the Estimated Bid Value or 2 orders each of 5 0 % of the Estimated Bid Value or 3 orders each of 40 st % of the Estimated Bid Value for similar service(s) in the last three years (ending with 31 October, 2026 ) to any Central / State Govt. Organization / PSU / Public Listed Company. Copies of contracts / work orde rs and documentary evidence of successful execution / completion in support of Past Experience of Simila r Services along with names, address and contact details of clients shall be uploaded with the bid for verif ication by the Buyer. ● Selected Firm will be required to deposit Performance Guarantee @ 2 % of the Work value which shall be in the form of DD /FDR/ Bank Guar antee in favor of the DDO, Ministry of Tribal Affairs. ● A random check will be conducted to inspect the freshness, quality and qu antity or otherwise of the 80 nos cut flowers arrangements. The decision of the organization in this regard will be binding on the Firm. ● No advance payment will be made to the organization. ● The bidder should adhere to the provisions of all laws in every respect. ● The Firm shall submit the bills after satisfactorily supplying the go ods so as to enable the organization to process the same and pay the firm. ● Any tax as per laws in force shall be paid by the Firm ● Any damages, loss or theft will have to be borne by the firm. ● Failure by the firm to comply with any statutory requirements and/or the terms of the agreement during the period of contract will re sult in termination of the contract and subsequent disqualification fro m participation in any future tender of the organization. ● The Firm will not sublet or transfer any part of the contract. ● If the quality of any items is found not satisfactory by this office, t hen the firm will be asked to replace them immediately without any ex

tra cost. ● The flower vase containing the flowers/leaves should be of glass and fresh flowers of good quality should be used. Adequate quantity of suitable leaves m ust be attached for each flower arrangement for an even spread of attractive fl ower arrangement. ● The Flowers bouquets / bunches as and when asked for, are to be delivere d to M/o Tribal Affairs, Kartavya Bhawan - 1 within 30 mins from the time given , failing which the payment of Flowers bouquets/bunches will not be made. The contractor may also be sometimes asked to deliver the Flowers bouquets at so me other place in Delhi, if required without any extra charges. ● Bidder must have their shop/ establishment within 10 kms. of our office at Kartavya Bhawan - 1, New Delhi (Copy of address proof of shop/establishment to be submitted). ● Pre-bid meeting mandatory for all vendors, the technical evaluation is vali d for those who attend the pre-bid meeting. ● Bidder must have excellent gem rating. ● Rates/prices should remain fixed during the entire period of the contr act and shall not be subject to variation on any account. No claim for c ompensation or loss due to fluctuations or any other reasons / causes s hall be entertained. A bid submitted with an adjustable price quotation shall be treated as non-responsive and shall be rejected. No request fo r increase in the rates would be entertained during the period of contr act. ● The Annual Rate Contract (ARC) shall initially be for a period of three year s. However, the ARC may be extended for a further period of 1 year with mutu al agreement on the same rate, terms and conditions, if the services of the con tractor are found satisfactory. ● AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Pr ovider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE T O BE SUBMITTED. ● Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support: BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. ● Third-Party Inspection/Certification: The bidder shall submit the documents d uly verified/certified by a NABCB-accredited Third-Party Inspection Agency (TPI A), as specified in the applicable annexure/tender conditions. The TPIA shall be registered under NABCB-accredited bodies as per the requir ements of ISO/IEC 17020, Type A, as listed on the QCI/NABCB website. The verification/certification shall clearly mention:

Ø Name of the certifying officer; Ø Contact telephone number; Ø E-mail ID; and Ø Name and address of the TPIA branch that carried out the cert ification. · Bank Solvency: The bidder shall submit a Bank Solvency Certificate/L etter for ₹30 lakh issued by a commercial/scheduled bank. The certific ate shall not be older than 180 days from the date of publication of the bid. Department may ask to submit the Original copy of solvency certific ate for verification. ● OPTION CLAUSE: The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. Howe ver, once the contract is issued, contract quantity or contract duration can onl y be increase up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quanti ty or duration.
